page.content:
Qatar — Messi's Argentina in a final against France.

How 2022 FIFA World Cup connects

  • Character: Lionel Messi — Messi won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina in Qatar.
  • Location: Lusail Stadium — The 2022 World Cup final was played at Lusail Stadium.
  • Topic: FIFA World Cup — The 2022 tournament is Messi's World Cup.
  • Faction: France national team — France met Argentina in the 2022 World Cup final.

What is 2022 FIFA World Cup?

The 2022 World Cup in Qatar was the first winter tournament in the Middle East. Argentina beat France on penalties after a final that already felt historic.

Key threads lead to Lionel Messi, Lusail Stadium, FIFA World Cup and France national team.
